name: Ranorex
description_en:
Ranorex Studio automates user-interface tests for desktop, web and mobile applications. Its workflow combines recorded actions, UI-element repositories and validation, with code and integration options for more involved test suites. Ranorex also markets separate test-design tooling, which should not be treated as identical Studio functionality.

This profile evaluates a proposed recorded UI flow, locator maintenance, cross-browser adaptation and a Windows CI execution path. It separates authoring from execution-only licensing and does not adopt coming-soon AI features as current. No installation, license server, browser, application, test or pipeline was operated.
description_zh:
Ranorex Studio 自动化桌面、网页及移动应用界面测试，将录制动作、界面元素仓库及验证组合，并提供代码和集成路径处理更复杂套件。Ranorex 也另行推广测试设计工具，不能视作相同 Studio 功能。

本文评估拟定录制流程、定位维护、跨浏览器适配及 Windows CI 路径，区分编写与仅执行许可，不将即将推出 AI 功能当作现行能力。本次未操作安装、许可服务器、浏览器、应用、测试或流水线。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_zh: 录制需要主动添加断言
sections.en: The first-test guide records a demo flow and separately selects an element and its Text attribute for validation. It recommends pausing for actions outside the test and setting display scaling to one hundred percent. Use an equivalent synthetic flow and inspect captured steps before replay. A sequence of successful clicks alone does not prove the intended result, and the sample project was not downloaded or run here.
sections.zh: 首次测试指南先录制演示流程，再独立选择元素及 Text 属性验证；建议对测试外动作暂停录制，并将显示缩放设为百分之百。应采用等价虚构流程，重放前检查捕获步骤。点击成功序列本身不证明预期结果，本次未下载或运行样本项目。

sections.title_en: Locator flexibility and precision need balancing
sections.title_zh: 定位灵活性与精度需平衡
sections.en: RanoreXPath uses an axis, UI role and optional attribute predicates within the UI hierarchy. Ranorex Spy exposes that structure. The guide notes that detailed paths can be faster but more brittle, while flexible paths can tolerate changes at a performance cost. Check that a path identifies the intended unique element after realistic UI changes; a broader wildcard is not automatically a correct repair.
sections.zh: RanoreXPath 在界面层级中使用轴、界面角色及可选属性条件，Ranorex Spy 可显示结构。指南说明详细路径可能更快却更脆弱，灵活路径可容忍变化却可能增加耗时。应在真实界面变化后检查路径仍唯一定位预期元素，更宽泛通配符不自动代表修复正确。

sections.title_en: A historical tutorial is not today’s browser support matrix
sections.title_zh: 历史教程不是当前浏览器支持矩阵
sections.en: The cross-browser guide adapts one recording for several browsers and validates an account attribute. Its example still names Internet Explorer and a third-party Dropbox login. Treat this as an explanation of adaptation, not a current entitlement list or an instruction to use real credentials. Verify supported browser/driver versions and target-specific UI differences before promising coverage. No third-party account or website was operated.
sections.zh: 跨浏览器指南将一份录制适配多浏览器，并验证账户属性；示例仍列 Internet Explorer 及第三方 Dropbox 登录。应将其当作适配方法，而非当前权益清单或使用真实凭据的指令。承诺覆盖前需核浏览器／驱动版本及目标界面差异，本次未操作第三方账户或网站。

sections.title_en: Execution can compete with authoring for a floating license
sections.title_zh: 执行可能与编写争用浮动许可
sections.en: The operating guide distinguishes node-locked perpetual licenses from floating perpetual/subscription models. Starting Studio leases Enterprise; an Agent run requests Runtime but can consume Enterprise if Runtime is unavailable. A lease is unavailable to other clients until returned, and a failed return can block it for five minutes. Size the pool for simultaneous authoring and execution, and inspect real lease behavior before diagnosing a waiting CI job as an application failure.
sections.zh: 运行指南区分固定机器永久许可及浮动永久／订阅模式。启动 Studio 租用 Enterprise；Agent 请求 Runtime，缺少时也可占 Enterprise。归还前许可不能给其他客户端，归还失败还可能阻塞五分钟。应按同时编写和执行配置许可池，排查等待 CI 时先检查实际租用行为，避免误判应用失败。

sections.title_en: The CI agent needs an interactive Windows desktop
sections.title_zh: CI Agent 需要交互式 Windows 桌面
sections.en: The Azure Pipelines guide requires a configured Windows agent with an interactive desktop session and access to the test solution. This differs from assuming any headless build worker can drive the UI. Check agent availability, user session, application prerequisites and license access before adding a pipeline. The documented YAML and classic options are setup choices, not evidence that a particular agent has passed a test.
sections.zh: Azure Pipelines 指南要求已配置交互式桌面的 Windows Agent，并可访问测试解决方案，不能假定任意无界面构建节点可驱动 UI。接入前应检查 Agent、用户会话、应用前提及许可访问。文档 YAML／经典选项只是设置选择，不证明特定 Agent 已通过测试。

sections.title_en: Changing a locator does not restore application data
sections.title_zh: 更改定位不会恢复应用数据
sections.en: UI automation acts on the selected application and user session. Review the recorded target and validation before repeating a failed write flow, especially when earlier steps may already have created records. Use controlled fixtures and deliberate cleanup in the proposed evaluation. The recording and locator tools help maintain test behavior; they are not an application transaction rollback or backup service. No repeat run or data recovery was attempted.
sections.zh: 界面自动化作用于所选应用及用户会话。重复失败写入流程前需检查录制目标及验证，尤其前面步骤可能已创建记录。拟定评估应采用受控样本及明确清理。录制／定位工具帮助维护测试行为，不是应用事务回滚或备份服务。本次未重跑或恢复数据。

sections.title_en: Request a quote for the actual authoring/runtime mix
sections.title_zh: 按实际编写／执行组合询价
sections.en: The public pricing route redirects to a licensing page with Request Pricing rather than numeric amounts. It distinguishes Enterprise authoring/editing/execution from Runtime execution only, and states that test creation requires an appropriate Studio license. DesignWise has separate plans. Keep license category, term, concurrent leases, support and infrastructure in the proposed quote. An execution-only purchase is not an authoring entitlement; no current amount or contract was obtained.
sections.zh: 公开价格入口跳转带 Request Pricing 的许可页，未列金额；区分 Enterprise 编写／编辑／执行与 Runtime 仅执行，并说明创建测试需相应 Studio 许可。DesignWise 另有方案。拟报价需包括许可类别、期限、并发租用、支持及设施，仅执行购买不等于编写权益。本次未获得现行金额或合同。
